snippet.title: AFTERMATH: Bunker Trader - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5056230/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=trailer&utm_campaign=announcement

A simulation game where your bunker becomes the safe space survivors need. Trade and craft items - organize them in storage. Scavenge the surface yourself and hire personnel to send on expeditions. Become the ultimate trading hub in this post-apocalyptic world.
